dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High visibility of multiple thin, curved pale gray bands across the coverts, creating a repetitive barred effect rather than a single distinct horizontal bar.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Highly prominent with sharp, high-contrast pale boundaries against dark charcoal-gray feather bodies.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive and uniform scalloped/scaly patterning across the entire dorsal surface from the crown to the upper tail coverts.
